title: Lock Upp Just Moved to Netflix — and 15 Celebrities Just Lost Their Phone Privileges
excerpt: Farah Khan and Riteish Deshmukh take over the jailer's chair, Ram Kapoor brings the chaos, Shreyas Iyer's sister walks in, and the reality show that once broke the internet is back — this time, the whole world gets to watch.
body:
The doors swung open at 8 PM on Saturday, and just like that, Lock Upp: Sach Ya Sazaa walked back into India's entertainment conversation like it never left. Except this time, it brought Netflix along for the ride.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=TaNLLEin_70

The second season of Ekta Kapoor's survival reality format premiered on Netflix on June 27, marking a massive platform upgrade from its previous home on MX Player and ALT Balaji. For the Indian diaspora — from New Jersey living rooms to London flatshares to Toronto basements — this is the part that matters: Lock Upp is now globally accessible, no VPN gymnastics required.

New Jailers, Same Ruthless Energy

Farah Khan and Riteish Deshmukh have replaced Kangana Ranaut as the show's jailers, and if the premiere is anything to go by, the chemistry between them is already electric. Farah, never one to hold back, opened by announcing that every contestant would wash their own clothes — the kind of domestic ultimatum that sounds simple until you're doing it on camera while fifteen other people are watching you unravel.

Riteish, for his part, promised to "ruin the strategies" of every contestant who walked in. He looked like he meant it.

The Inmates: From TV Royalty to Cricket's Inner Circle

![Lock Upp — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/2/20/Lock_Upp_logo.jpg)

> "Sunita Ahuja — wife of comedian Govinda — arrived as a "newsmaker," which in Lock Upp parlance means the producers expect her to say things that trend at midnight."

The contestant lineup reads like a casting director's fever dream in the best possible way.

Ram Kapoor — the man who made *Bade Achhe Lagte Hain* appointment viewing — walked in with the kind of unfiltered energy that immediately shifted the room's centre of gravity. Harshad Chopda, one of television's most private leading men, is an unexpected but intriguing choice. Shivangi Joshi and Dheeraj Dhoopar bring massive TV fanbases that practically guarantee first-week social media wars.

But the real headline? Shreshta Iyer, younger sister of Indian cricket star Shreyas Iyer, entering the jail. Cricket and reality television have rarely intersected this directly, and the curiosity factor alone is significant.

Sunita Ahuja — wife of comedian Govinda — arrived as a "newsmaker," which in Lock Upp parlance means the producers expect her to say things that trend at midnight. Riyaz Aly, one of India's biggest social media stars with over 50 million Instagram followers, represents the creator economy's growing crossover into mainstream entertainment. Pamela Sarena from Netflix's *Desi Bling* adds international flavour, while content creator Shreya Kalra and fashion personality Sufi Motiwala round out a roster that's been carefully designed to collide.

> "The raw and real Yogesh that people connected with is exactly what they're going to see inside Lock Upp." — Yogesh Rawat

Speaking of collisions: Yogesh Rawat and Akanksha Chaudhary, whose complicated relationship became tabloid fodder on another reality show, are both in the house. The producers know exactly what they're doing.

![Kangana Ranaut — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f4/Kangana_Ranaut_at_Ira_Khan%27s_wedding_reception_%28cropped%29.jpg)

The Netflix Effect

This is the detail that transforms Lock Upp from a domestic guilty pleasure into a genuinely global play. Netflix's reach across the US, UK, Canada, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia means the show now has access to an Indian diaspora audience that historically had to chase reality television through clips and illegal streams.

The format — six weeks, new episodes streaming Saturday through Wednesday at 8 PM IST — is designed for the kind of daily appointment viewing that builds community. Expect the group chats and Twitter threads to start within the hour.

Season 1 winner Munawar Faruqui returned for a promo tour of the revamped jail set, and Urfi Javed made a characteristic guest appearance in the premiere, owning every second of screen time she was given.

The Verdict So Far

One episode in, and the show already has its first controversy (Akanksha Chamola's revelations), its first power dynamic (Ram Kapoor vs. everyone), and its first viral moment (Dheeraj Dhoopar's attempted "escape" during his entrance). The ingredients are there.

Whether Lock Upp Season 2 can match the cultural noise of its predecessor — which turned Munawar Faruqui into a household name and generated over a billion streaming minutes — depends on whether these 15 personalities can sustain the drama beyond the first week's novelty. But with Farah Khan holding the keys, the odds look solid.

*Lock Upp: Sach Ya Sazaa streams on Netflix. New episodes drop Saturday through Wednesday at 8 PM IST.*
